label: Bible Study
prompt: And that from a child thou hast known the holy _____, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
verse: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
note: Timothy learned the scriptures early — Paul credits his grandmother Lois and mother Eunice.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new _____ and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.
verse: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.
note: Peter looks forward to new heavens and a new earth where righteousness is finally at home.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put a trumpet in every man's hand, with empty pitchers, and _____ within the pitchers.
verse: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put a trumpet in every man's hand, with empty pitchers, and lamps within the pitchers.
note: Three hundred men, each with a trumpet and a lamp hidden in an empty pitcher — Gideon's whole battle plan.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Woe to them that are at _____ in Zion, and trust in the mountain of Samaria, which are named chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel came!
verse: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion, and trust in the mountain of Samaria, which are named chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel came!
note: Amos's woe to the comfortable elite of Samaria, lounging on ivory beds while the nation decayed.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And her prophets have daubed them with _____ morter, seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord GOD, when the LORD hath not spoken.
verse: And her prophets have daubed them with untempered morter, seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord GOD, when the LORD hath not spoken.
note: False prophets 'daubed' a crumbling wall with 'untempered morter' — whitewash that won't hold. Yes, the KJV spells it morter.
